standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the etale R -> R' with trivial residue extension and the map B -> R'.

standard_prerequisites.use: Retracts R' back to R, bringing the solution into R.

core_obligations: Subtract approximants c_i in R with a_i - c_i in m^N and write a_i = c_i + sum a_{i,l} d_l over generators d_l of m^N; the substituted system g_j = 0 in R[x_{i,l}] has the solution (a_{i,l}) in R^wedge.
It suffices to solve g_j = 0 over R: then b_i = c_i + sum b_{i,l} d_l solves f_j = 0 and is congruent to a_i modulo m^N.
Let A be the R-subalgebra of R^wedge generated by the solution; since R is a G-ring the map R -> R^wedge is regular, so Popescu's theorem factors A -> B -> R^wedge with B smooth over R.

Lift the section B -> kappa through the smooth B -> Spec kappa by an etale R -> R' with R/m isomorphic to R'/mR' and an R-algebra map B -> R'; since R is henselian the etale map has a section R' -> R.
The images b_i of the solution generators under A -> B -> R' -> R form the wanted solution in R.
proof_roadmap: Coefficient rewriting; reduction to the substituted system; Popescu factorization; etale section lifting; henselian retraction.
difficulty_reason: A five-step argument; the substance is the Popescu factorization of the solution subalgebra and the section-lifting pair, all carried.
